question: How many SCOTUS cases are in the set? Name them.
answer_found: There are 5 SCOTUS cases in the set: Bell Atlantic Corp. v. Twombly, Eastman Kodak Co. v. Image Technical Services, Inc., United States v. Socony-Vacuum Oil Co., Inc., Standard Oil Co. of New Jersey v. United States, and Brown Shoe Co., Inc. v. United States.
